{{short description|German scientist and author (born 1951)}}
'''Harald Specht''' (born 20 December 1951) is a German scientist and author. He published the first German monograph on issues of cold shortening and electrical stimulation,<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=66_XAAAACAAJ|title=Kälteverkürzung und Elektrostimulation bei Fleisch: Untersuchungen an Schaf- und Rindfleisch|first=Harald|last=Specht|date=July 23, 1990|publisher=Fachbuchverl.|isbn=978-3-343-00534-5|via=Google Books}}</ref><ref>H. Sielaff, Humboldt-Univ. zu Berlin in journal “Fleisch”, 43 (7), 1989. and also K. O. Honikel, Institut für Fleischforschung Kulmbach, review in journal ''Fleischwirtschaft'', 70 (9), 1990.</ref>
but he became mainly known for his books about Jesus of Nazareth and early Christianity<ref>H. Detering: “Harald Specht: Jesus? Tatsachen und Erfindungen”, review in journal „Aufklaerung und Kritik”, Zeitschrift für freies Denken und humanistische Philosophie, Nuernberg, 18. Jahrgang, 2/2011 ISSN 0945-6627, p. 241 ff</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=Denken statt glauben: Wie das Christentum wirklich entstanden ist|id={{ASIN|3739247568|country=de}}}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=A. Markt-Huter|title="Harald Specht: Das Erbe des Heidentums", review in: Lesen in Tirol, Tiroler Bildungsservice|date=August 2016|url=https://lesen.tibs.at/content/erwachsene/harald-specht-das-erbe-des-heidentums|website=Lesen.tibs.at}}</ref> in which he doubts the [[historicity of Jesus]] of Nazareth. He also argues that the development of Christianity is a result of religious and political disputes on the basis of ancient pagan sources.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.freigeist-weimar.de/beitragsanzeige/ueber-das-erbe-des-heidentums-im-christlichen-abendland/|title=Freigeist Weimar: Über das Erbe des Heidentums im "christlichen" Abendland|website=Freigeist-weimar.de}}</ref><ref>H. Detering:"Wie das Abendland christlich wurde", review in: Radikalkritik – Beitraege zur historischen Kritik der fruehchristlichen Geschichte", 2/2017</ref>

==Life==
Specht was born in [[Koethen]] (Anhalt). He studied at the [[University of Halle-Wittenberg]] and graduated in 1978 with a doctoral thesis to Dr. rer. nat.<ref>Harald Specht: “Zur Herstellung, Charakterisierung und Anwendung von NaHg-Mordeniten, Dissertationsschrift", Martin-Luther-Univ. Halle-Wittenberg 1978</ref> In 1986 he obtained his post-doctoral qualification at the [[Humboldt University]] of Berlin to Dr.-Ing. habil. in the field of food technology.<ref>Harald Specht: “Untersuchungen zum cold shortening und zur Elektrostimulation von Schaf- und Rindfleisch", Habilitationsschrift, Humboldt-Univ. zu Berlin, 1986</ref> In 1987 he became a university lecturer at the Technical University Koethen and later at the [[Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg]].

==Activity as a scientist and author== 
As chemist and food technologist Specht worked mainly on problems of air separation and also catalysis<ref>Harald Specht: “Zum Praeadsorptionseinfluß von Wasser und Kohlendioxid auf die adsorptive Lufttrennung an zeolithischen Molekularsieben”, Diplomarbeit, Martin-Luther-Univ. Halle-Wittenberg 1974</ref> and cold treatment of meat.<ref>Harald Specht: “Untersuchungen zum cold shortening und zur Elektrostimulation von Schaf- und Rindfleisch”, Habilitationsschrift, Humboldt-Univ. zu Berlin, 1986</ref> He was a member of the [[German Chemical Society]] and also of editorial advisory boards<ref>from 1985 Member of editorial advisory board of  journals “Fleisch”  and “Lebensmittelindustrie” of Fachbuchverlag Leipzig and Verlag Karlheinz Holz</ref> as well as of brain trusts.<ref>from 1986–1990 Member in Wissenschaftlicher Rat der Hauptforschungsrichtung Ernaehrung</ref> 
In addition to publishing numerous scientific publications<ref>e.g. Karl-Heinz Bergk, Harald Specht, Friedrich Wolf: “Zur Dekationisierung von NaHg-Mordeniten”, Z. Chem. 20 (1980), Heft 6, S. 233–234. *Harald Specht und Joerg Kunis: “Electrical stimulation – an effective method to produce meat of high quality”, Acta Alimentaria Polonica, Vol. XIV (XXXVIII) No. 1 (1988), S. 73–79. *Harald Specht und Joerg Kunis: “Effects of combined prae- and postmortal electrical stimulation on the quality of meat”, IIR Meat Chilling Symposion, Com. C.2, 10.–12. September 1986, University of Bristol, Bristol 1986, UK, S. 45–51. *Harald Specht und Joerg Kunis: “The ph-value as an indicator for the primary cooling of muscle meat – the influence of electrical stimulation and cooling on postmortem glycolysis”, XVIIth Intern. Congr. Refrig., Wien, Com. C2, 4.–29. August 1987, Proceedings Vol. C, S. 240–245.</ref> Harald Specht operated increasingly also as a filmmaker<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.igm-bosch.de/content/language1/downloads/IGM_Videosammlung.pdf|title=Video-Sammlung IGM|website=Igm-bosch.de|accessdate=23 July 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://talk.hbo.com/t5/Real-Time-with-Bill-Maher/Robert-M-Price-rebuts-O-Reilly-in-Killing-History-Nuskeptix/td-p/469265 |title=Robert M. Price rebuts O'Reilly in 'Killing History... - HBO Talk |website=talk.hbo.com |access-date=2 February 2022 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20160422115241/http://talk.hbo.com/t5/Real-Time-with-Bill-Maher/Robert-M-Price-rebuts-O-Reilly-in-Killing-History-Nuskeptix/td-p/469265 |archive-date=22 April 2016 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>Report in Newspaper "Mitteldeutsche Zeitung", 14.Mai 1997: "Video ueber Lutze-Klinik vorgestellt-Koethener Filmautoren Specht und Donath fertigen Dokumentation an..." – Report in Newspaper "Mitteldeutsche Zeitung", 21.3.2001: "Video ueber Koethen gezeigt" – Report in Newspaper "Mitteldeutsche Zeitung", 27. Okt. 2001, p. 13: "Video-Produktion: In Bild und Ton Wesentliches für die Nachwelt festhalten"</ref> and book author.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&query=130087580|title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek|website=Portal.dnb.de}}</ref> He wrote screenplays, film commentaries<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://temporati.de/Harald_Specht.html%7CRundfunk,_Film__und__Fernsehen |title=Lebenslauf von Harald Specht - Rundfunk, Film & Fernsehen - Temporati |access-date=2016-11-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160918095315/http://temporati.de/Harald_Specht.html%7CRundfunk,_Film__und__Fernsehen |archive-date=2016-09-18 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and novels but mainly non-fiction books on cultural, historical, philosophical and religious studies topics (see works – book selection). Here Specht argued that some contents of the New Testament are not historical occurrences but are compiled inventions of the second century and later.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://radikalkritik.de/?s=specht|title=Suchergebnisse für "specht" |website=Radikalkritik.ded_sp}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.freigeist-weimar.de/beitragsanzeige/jesus-christus-was-ist-belegte-tatsache-was-blosse-erfindung/|title=Freigeist Weimar: Jesus Christus: Was ist belegte Tatsache, was bloße Erfindung?|website=Freigeist-weimar.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jesus-lebt-wirklich.de/43.html|title=Das Erbe des Heidentums – Jesus lebt wirklich|website=Jesus-lebt-wirklich.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.gbs-rhein-neckar.de/leserbriefe/was-bleibt-christentum-ohne-jesus|title=Was bleibt vom Christentum ohne Jesus? &#124; Säkulare Humanisten GBS Rhein-Neckar e.V. — Regionalgruppe der Giordano-Bruno-Stiftung|website=Gbs-rhein-neckar.de}}</ref> Furthermore, he doubts the Paul's authorship of the St. Paul's epistles.<ref>(Quote R. Weber: "''Es gibt also auch mit der Sichtweise Spechts recht gute Gruende dafuer, dass Paulus eine spaetere Erfindung ist.''" in: R. Weber: “Denken statt glauben – Wie das Christentum wirklich entstanden ist”, Norderstedt 2015, p 212 ff. Quote on page 222,</ref>
